articles.image_title: Ukrainischer Soldat: 04/07/2026 Velykyi Doroshiv, Lviv region, Ukraine. Place where alleged remaints of Deletskyi were buried next to his father's grave. ..Nazar Daletskyi, a Ukrainian soldier, returned home on February 5, 2026, after nearly three years in Russian captivity - despite having been officially declared dead.
